title: drivers license
lyrics:
[00:00.000] 作词 : Olivia Rodrigo/Daniel Nigro
[00:01.000] 作曲 : Olivia Rodrigo/Daniel Nigro
[00:02.000] 编曲 : Daniel Nigro
[00:03.000] 制作人 : Daniel Nigro
[00:08.477]I got my driver's license last week
[00:11.638]Just like we always talked about
[00:15.008]'Cause you were so excited for me
[00:18.430]To finally drive up to your house
[00:21.382]But today I drove through the suburbs
[00:24.699]Crying 'cause you weren't around
[00:28.147]
[00:31.543]And you're probably with that blonde girl
[00:35.044]Who always made me doubt
[00:38.335]She's so much older than me
[00:40.869]She's everything I'm insecure about
[00:43.873]Yeah, today I drove through the suburbs
[00:47.922]'Cause how could I ever love someone else?
[00:52.337]
[00:54.270]And I know we weren't perfect but I've never felt this way for no one
[01:04.222]And I just can't imagine how you could be so okay now that I'm gone
[01:14.123]Guess you didn't mean what you wrote in that song about me
[01:20.915]'Cause you said forever now I drive alone past your street
[01:25.904]
[01:28.490]And all my friends are tired
[01:31.285]Of hearing how much I miss you but
[01:35.125]I kinda feel sorry for them
[01:37.607]'Cause they'll never know you the way that I do
[01:40.611]Yeah, today I drove through the suburbs
[01:44.216]And pictured I was driving home to you
[01:49.310]
[01:50.903]And I know we weren't perfect but I've never felt this way for no one

[02:10.495]I guess you didn't mean what you wrote in that song about me
[02:17.627]'Cause you said forever now I drive alone past your street
[02:22.433]
[02:24.471]Red lights
[02:26.012]Stop signs
[02:27.605]I still see your face
[02:30.453]In the white cars
[02:32.621]Front yards
[02:34.267]Can't drive past the places
[02:37.218]We used to
[02:39.282]Go to
[02:40.876]'Cause I still fu*king love you, babe
[02:46.022]
[02:51.011]Sidewalks
[02:52.578]We crossed
[02:54.355]I still hear your voice
[02:56.784]In the traffic
[02:58.796]We're laughing
[03:01.042]Over all the noise
[03:03.419]God I'm so blue
[03:05.587]Know we're through
[03:07.520]But I still fu*king love you, babe

[03:17.734]I know we weren't perfect but I've never felt this way for no one

[03:50.858]Yeah, you said forever now I drive alone past your street
